matches.rationale: Both identify manipulated/inflated accuracy numbers for AC-ViT in Table 2, constituting evidence data integrity violation. Finding explicitly notes the caption admits adjusted values to exaggerate advantage.

The finding describes methodological inconsistencies in Section 2.2's gradient decomposition, including non-linear behavior, omitted scaling factors, and contradictions in the theoretical framework. This matches the ground truth's description of ambiguous definitions, unsupported claims, and logical incoherence in the same section.
No finding addresses the unequal training epoch comparison (700 vs. 300 epochs) between AC-ViT and Residual ViT. The hyperparameter omission finding covers different details.

No finding mentions the Conclusion section or the overgeneralized claim that ACNs 'match or outperform residual baselines' without sufficient caveats. The available findings are unrelated to this claim distortion.
The ground truth describes fabricated citations and omitted prior work in the Related Work section. None of the findings discuss reference fabrication or omission.
The ground truth notes the absence of environmental/energy impact discussion regarding longer training times. No finding covers this ethical omission.

The ground truth points out that the abstract's claim of up to 18% reduction in forgetting lacks necessary context about architecture and regularizer specificity. The only abstract-related finding (pred_id 6) highlights a numerical inconsistency with Table 3, which is a different scientific issue.
The ground truth identifies overly promotional language in the Introduction. No finding addresses rhetorical presentation manipulation in the Introduction.
Both describe deliberate manipulation of Figure 6's test loss curve to exaggerate AC-Mixer's advantage, an evidence data integrity violation.

The finding explicitly notes omitted hyperparameter details in Section 4.2.1, limiting reproducibility. This directly corresponds to the ground truth's complaint about missing experimental protocol details that reduce reproducibility.
The ground truth criticizes the overgeneralization of the 18% forgetting reduction from a narrow benchmark to imply general superiority. No finding addresses this claim scope distortion.
The ground truth identifies promotional phrases in the Abstract. None of the findings cover rhetorical presentation manipulation in the Abstract.
The ground truth points out the omission of fairness/bias considerations in the Discussion. No finding mentions this ethical oversight.
The ground truth describes inequitable comparison due to different training budgets for baselines. No finding captures this experimental design protocol issue.
The ground truth describes overly smooth plots lacking error bars in Figures 2 and 3. No finding addresses these evidence presentation issues.

The ground truth highlights an inconsistency between the claimed linear backward path count in Section 2.2 and later experimental heatmaps. No finding mentions this cross-section theory-experiment misalignment.
